newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- French exports to Saudi Arabia recorded 51 percent growth in the first half of 1997.
- Local distributors record unprecendeted high tobacco cigarettes sales following a move by the government to increase tariffs on tobacco products to 100 percent.
- King Fahd to receive members of the expanded Shura council on Monday.
- Saudi sends shipment of relief goods to Bosnia Moslems.
- Real estate fund approves loans worth 493 million riyals to Saudi nationals.
- Egypt and Saudi Arabia urge Western countries to work to stop campaigns against Islam.
- A Saudi-Yemeni joint committee on border demarcation is to meet in Jeddah on Monday.
